'''Business and economy'''
*[[Argentina–Brazil relations]]
**After eight months of deficit, October becomes the second positive month for trade between [[Argentina]] and [[Brazil]]. Argentina ended a record seven years of surpluses as the market was boosted by iron and steel. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/11/04/argentina-s-trade-balance-with-brazil-ends-up-positive-for-2nd-straight-month (MercoPress)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Lagos high-rise collapse]]
**The death toll from the [[structural integrity and failure|collapse]] of a building three days ago in [[Ikoyi]], [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]], increases to 36. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/4/death-toll-in-nigeria-building-collapse-rises-to-more-than-30 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports a record 6,310 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 483,142. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-11-covid-cases-croatia-high.html (Medical Xpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 33,949 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, surpassing the previous record of 33,777 new cases reported on December 18, 2020. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/11/04/germany-reports-a-record-number-of-new-covid-19-cases (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 1,195 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 243,255. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/russia-registers-new-record-number-of-daily-coronavirus-deaths/2411788 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] reports a record 6,713 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-slovakia/slovakia-reports-6713-new-covid-19-cases-record-daily-tally-idUSL8N2RV3BX (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] surpasses three million cases of COVID-19 after reporting a record 27,377 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/3344578-covid-in-ukraine-daily-cases-hit-27377-as-of-nov-4.html (Ukrinform)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]] grants conditional authorisation to [[Merck & Co.|Merck]]'s [[molnupiravir]], which can be used to treat symptomatic COVID-19 patients, making the [[United Kingdom]] the first country to approve the world's first COVID-19 antiviral [[Route of administration|oral drug]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-59163899 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
***The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] announces January 4, 2022 as a deadline for private companies to require their employees fully vaccinated against COVID-19 or face weekly [[COVID-19 testing|testing]] in an effort to encourage private businesses to prevent the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/04/business/biden-vaccine-mandate-osha.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2020–2021 H5N8 outbreak]]
**The [[Netherlands]] reports an outbreak of the highly pathogenic [[H5N1]] [[bird flu]] among ducks at a [[poultry farm]] in the central [[provinces of the Netherlands|province]] of [[Flevoland]]. To reduce the spread of the virus, the [[Politics of the Netherlands|Dutch government]] will kill 10,000 animals. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-11-04/netherlands-reports-bird-flu-outbreak-among-ducks-at-poultry-farm (U.S. News & World Report)]

'''Law and crime'''
*During his trial at [[Maidstone]] [[Crown Court]] in [[Kent]], England, [[David Fuller]] admits two [[murder in English law|murders]] and the [[sexual abuse]] of at least 100 [[corpse]]s. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-kent-59167648 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 United States elections]]
**[[2021 New Jersey State Senate election]]
***In an [[Upset (competition)|upset]], truck driver [[Edward Durr]] defeats longtime [[New Jersey Senate]] president [[Stephen M. Sweeney]] to represent [[New Jersey]]'s [[New Jersey's 3rd legislative district|3rd legislative district]] after the [[Associated Press]] called the race for him. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/edward-durr-new-jersey-senate-steve-sweeney/ (CBS News)]
*[[Politics of Portugal]]
**[[President of Portugal]] [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]] calls a [[snap election]] for January 30 after the [[Socialist Party (Portugal)|Socialist Party]] was defeated in a key budget vote last week. [https://www.politico.eu/article/portugal-headed-for-snap-election-marcelo-rebelo-de-sousa/ (''Politico Europe'')]
*[[Pope Francis]] appoints [[Raffaella Petrini]] as the new secretary general of the [[Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State]], becoming the highest-ranking woman in the [[Roman Curia]] and the first woman to ever hold the position. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2021-11/sr-raffaella-petrini-appointed-secretary-general-of-governorate.html (''Vatican News'')]
